title: LogEntry
description: One line of the operation log.

doc.description: Project-relative path of the document the op applies to.

id.description: ULID: unique, and sorts by time.

oneOf.description:
Open a file. Records its content hash, so replay can check it starts
from the same input.

Create an independent unsaved DNA sequence. The initial residues are
retained so recovery and replay do not need an external source file.
Save a document. Records the hash of each file written.

Replace residues `start..end` with `residues`. Insertions and
deletions are replacements with an empty side.

Write residues `start..end` and the annotations within them to a new
file at `path`. Annotations cut by the range are clipped and marked
incomplete at the cut. Records the new file's hash.

reverse.description:
Write the reverse complement, so a reverse-strand annotation
reads 5' to 3' in the new file.

segments.description: Parts to splice together, 5' to 3', instead of `start..end`.

oneOf.description: Replace columns `start..end` of one row with `residues`.

Insert `residues` before column `col` in `rows`. Like gaps, they use
up each row's trailing gaps first, unless every row gets them.
Type one residue, or a gap, over the block `rows` × `start..end`.

Insert `count` gaps before column `col`. Rows use up their own
trailing gaps first, unless every row gets gaps: that's a new column.
Delete columns `start..end` of `rows`; what follows moves left.

Slide the block `rows` × `start..end` by `by` columns into the gaps
beside it.
Delete every column that is a gap in all rows.

Move `rows`, in order, so the first lands at index `to` among the
rows that remain.

Append sequences, optionally replacing reference rows with their
gap-expanded forms from an alignment addition tool.
Root the tree halfway along the branch above `clade`.
Root halfway along a longest tip-to-tip branch-length path.
Globally minimize unweighted root-to-all-tip distance variance.

Move the root along its branch: `clade`, one of the root's two
children, gets `fraction` of the branch's length, the other the
rest.
Reverse the order of the clade's children.

Order every node's children by size: smallest first (on top), or
largest first.

Add, change (same `id`) or, with no annotation, remove a clade
annotation.

A set of support values, such as bootstraps from another analysis:
one per internal node in preorder, as text.

source.description: Where the values came from, for the record.

remove_supports.description: Support sets removed on accepting Style; cancellation makes no edits.

oneOf.description:
A figure or other derived file written from a document, such as a
tree as SVG. The result holds its hash; replay doesn't rewrite it.

A plugin operation that reads and writes files, such as an aligner.
`inputs` and `outputs` are project-relative paths; the result holds
their content hashes. The actor names the tool and its version.
An atomic species-hypothesis edit against a workspace.
An atomic edit to the project's specimen and taxon metadata.
An atomic edit to a GenBank marker submission document.
A terminal job record, including failures and cancellation.
Undo the operation with log id `of`.
Redo the operation with log id `of`.

accession.description: Accession, with its version when the archive gave one.

AccessionPolicy.description:
Legacy suggestions are retained on old documents. Configured sources prevent
specimen identifiers elsewhere in a name from influencing inclusion suggestions.

Actor.description:
Who made a change: a person in the GUI (`human`), a script through the
CLI or Python API (`script`), an assistant over MCP (`agent`), or a tool,
plugin or outside program. New kinds are additive; older records keep
their kinds.

oneOf.description: An assistant over MCP, named by its client's model ID.

A script driving Basecraft through the CLI or the Python API, named by
its client (for example `CLI` or `Python`).
A change Basecraft detected on disk but didn't make.

middle.description:
Middle names or initials, without the first name's, such as `Marie` or `M.R.`.
Bare uppercase runs (`MR`) retain their legacy initials meaning; uppercase full names are ambiguous.

BatchSettings.description: Settings shared by every record of the batch.

organelle.description: The organelle the marker is from; none for nuclear markers.

Cell.description:
One value. The variant must match its column's kind; any column may hold
a missing-value reason instead.

oneOf.description: Latitude or longitude in decimal degrees.

CellChange.description: One value to set, or with no value, to clear.

ChangeSet.description:
Additions and updates applied together: one undo step. Every import
route produces one, reviewed before it is applied.

links.description: New links, or replacements for a record's existing link.

specimens.description: New specimen IDs, appended to the roster.

taxa.description: New taxa, or replacements for taxa with the same ID.

CladeAnnotation.description:
A highlighted clade: a name on its stem branch, a bar along its tips, a
field of colour behind it, or any mix of these.

bar.description: Draw a bar along the clade's tips, labelled beside it.

colour.description: `#rrggbb`, for the bar and the field.

field.description: Fill the area the clade covers.

on_branch.description: Write the label on the clade's stem branch.

opacity_left.description:
The field's opacity at its left and right edges, in percent. Two
different values make a gradient.

name.description:
A Darwin Core term (`catalogNumber`, `eventDate`, ...) or a user name:
an ASCII letter followed by letters, digits or underscores.

ColumnKind.description: What a column holds. Every kind also accepts an INSDC missing-value reason.

oneOf.description: A calendar date at its true precision: year, year and month, or day.
WGS84 decimal degrees, -90 to 90.
WGS84 decimal degrees, -180 to 180.
A number, in `unit` when given.
One of `levels`.

ColumnStyle.description: How one hypothesis column is drawn. Unset fields follow the theme.

gap.description:
Pixels between the previous column and this one; the first column
has none. Unset: 1.5 bar widths.

names.description: Write the species names to the right of the bars.

spacing.description:
Pixels between one species' bar and the next down the column.
Unset: 0.65 bar widths.

Decision.description: What to do with a row.

oneOf.description: A newly generated sequence, exported for submission.

Already in an archive (a downloaded reference, or submitted
before); not exported.
Left out of the submission.

DelimitationEdit.description: One atomic edit. Inferred and imported results must first be derived.

oneOf.description:
Explicit workspace specimen -> project roster ID links. Empty replaces
all links with unlinked status; local scientific IDs stay unchanged.

metadata.description: Standard source reference, with the metadata's existing owner activity.

oneOf.description: Import a validated batch without splitting lineage across separate edits.
Drop hypotheses. Refused while a kept hypothesis was copied from one.

columns.description: Hypothesis ID to its bar column style.

tree_edits.description:
How the display tree is drawn here: the tree editor's own drawing
edits, replayed in order on the display tree. Its file is not changed.

DocState.description:
A cheap fingerprint of a document after an operation. Replay compares
it at every step; full content hashes are compared at open and save.

features.description: Annotations: features of a sequence, clade annotations of a tree.

len.description: Residues of a sequence, columns of an alignment, tips of a tree.

EndPolicy.description: How the feature's ends are marked.

oneOf.description:
Coding markers: an end is complete when it has a start (5') or stop
(3') codon in frame. Other markers: both ends partial.
Both ends partial.
Both ends complete.

ExportMapping.description: Retained identities for interpreting archive returns after later selection edits.

records.description: Submitted `SeqID` to original biological record name.

trim_terminal_unknown.description:
Remove runs of unknown bases (N, ?) at the ends of each record.
The trimmed lengths are recorded in the coordinate map.

Feature.description:
A feature: a type, a location and qualifiers. GFF3 attributes map to
qualifiers too, with `ID` and `Parent` kept as ordinary qualifiers.

oneOf.description: The specimen's local ID: the key that rows are matched on.
A sequence record ID to link to the row's specimen.
A taxon name; the specimen is identified as that taxon.
A value for a specimen column.

FileStamp.description:
Cheap change signal captured during an existing verified read. Matching time
and length alone do not prove content identity.

FrameChoice.description: A reading frame the user reviewed for one record.

codon_start.description: 1, 2 or 3: the first base of the first complete codon.

HeaderPattern.description:
How to read fields from structured FASTA headers, such as
`HV1234|Caulerpa taxifolia|2019-05-12`.

fields.description: What each field holds, in order. Fields past the end are ignored.

separator.description: Splits the header line (without `>`). Must not be empty.

Identification.description:
A recorded assignment of a specimen to a taxon. Re-identification adds
another; it never overwrites the earlier one.

IdentifierSource.description:
Identifier fields use the same literal splitting primitive as metadata header imports.
Submission rules always use the FASTA identifier, never the full description header.

ImportSettings.description: Saved import settings, so a project's next import repeats its last one.

fingerprint.description: Hash of target content, source bytes and metadata evidence; recomputed before apply.

hash.description: Source bytes hash reused from the verified document read.

oneOf.description: Small subunit (18S) ribosomal RNA.
Large subunit (28S) ribosomal RNA.

Location.description:
A feature location: segments in biological order, 5' to 3' of the
feature. A reverse-strand two-exon gene lists its downstream exon first.
Locations crossing the origin of a circular sequence are split into two
segments at the origin.

unordered.description:
GenBank `order()`: the segments' order is unknown, as opposed to
`join()`, where they are joined in the given order.

Marker.description: The marker type, which decides the one feature each record gets.

oneOf.description: A protein-coding gene: a `gene` and a `CDS` feature.

gene.description: Gene symbol, such as `rbcL`; may be empty.

oneOf.description: A ribosomal RNA gene, such as `18S ribosomal RNA`.

The ITS region: one `misc_RNA` with a note listing the components
present. Internal boundaries are not annotated.

A non-coding region, such as an intergenic spacer: one
`misc_feature` with this description as its note.
Add or replace a project partition using the shared hypothesis model.
Refused while a removed specimen has identifications or links.
Remove a column and its values.

Withdraw identifications recorded in error. Re-identification adds a
new identification instead.

MissingReason.description:
Why a value is missing: the INSDC missing-value vocabulary, written as
INSDC writes it.

feature.description: Id assigned to a new feature.

hashes.description: Content hashes of files read or written, by project-relative path.

PartialDate.description: A date at year, month or day precision

haplotypes.description: Representative ID to original specimen IDs; never likelihood weights.

Publication.description: The publication the sequences belong to, written to the `.sbt`.

RecordLink.description:
A stored link from a sequence record to the specimen it came from. Many
records may link to one specimen. Links are made at import and never
re-derived from names.

RecordRef.description: A sequence record in a project document.

document.description: Project-relative path of the sequence file.

record.description:
The record's ID: its FASTA header up to the first whitespace, or its
alignment row name.

RowDecision.description: What to do with a row.

oneOf.description: A newly generated sequence, exported for submission.

Already in an archive (a downloaded reference, or submitted
before); not exported.
Left out of the submission.

Segment.description: One contiguous piece of a feature's location.

SourceAlignment.description:
An alignment file inside the project and the BLAKE3 hash of the bytes
the submission was prepared from. A different file content is refused
until the source is selected again.

columns.description: Source column header to what it holds. Unmapped columns are ignored.

oneOf.description: Select the source alignment (or accept a changed one).
Set the decision of these rows.
Confirm the selection fingerprint returned by submission review.

Save annotation settings with type-specific drafts. Legacy `set_batch`
retains its historical meaning so previously saved histories replay exactly.
Confirm or choose reading frames; `clear` forgets choices.
Both citations in one undoable change. Disabled custom publication values are retained.
Apply a reviewed rule. The shared ops boundary checks this plan against live inputs.
Retain the mapping after writing a submission package.
Record accessions returned by the archive.

SupportKind.description: Scientific support semantics supplied by a producer, never guessed from its name.

oneOf.description: Percentage support from a method other than ordinary bootstrap.

SupportPlacement.description: Where support values sit relative to their branch.

oneOf.description:
Above branches that go up from their parent, below those that go
down.

SupportSymbols.description:
Support shown as filled circles at nodes: dark at or above `high`
percent, grey at or above `low`, white below, as in many published
trees. Proportions count as percentages, as for `support_min`.

set.description: The support set the circles show.

Taxon.description: A taxon that specimens can be identified as.

name.description: The name used in this project's research.

submitted_name.description:
The name to submit when it differs, such as an informal name for an
undescribed species (`Caulerpa sp. 3 HV-2026`).

TreeDrawingEdit.description:
A tree editor edit that changes only how a tree is drawn. Written as the
matching operation (`tree.rotate`, `tree.ladderize`, `tree.style`).

TreeStyle.description: How a tree is drawn. Sizes are pixels at 100 % zoom.

support_decimals.description: Decimal places per set; missing entries use the support semantics. Maximum 10.

support_fraction.description: Display conversion only: true renders fractions, false percentages.

support_legend.description: Show an ordered legend when more than one support set is displayed.

support_min.description:
Hide support values below this percentage. Known producer metadata sets
the scale; ambiguous imported sets with all finite values in 0–1 use
proportions. Legacy `support_proportions` overrides only Unknown imports. 0 shows all.

support_minimums.description: Per-set thresholds in percent, falling back to `support_min`.

support_proportions.description: Legacy source-unit interpretation for Unknown imports only (true means 0–1).

support_shown.description:
Support sets shown at nodes, in order, joined with "/". Empty shows
every set.

tip_labels.description: Display-only labels keyed by original tip identity.

vertical_bar_labels.description: Write clade labels beside bars top to bottom, rather than across.
